responsibility: This module provides GNU Modula-2’s minimal link-time runtime library for very small, freestanding, or embedded builds where the full gm2 runtime is not desired. Its core role is to supply just enough standard Modula-2 support units and C-side symbols for generated code to compile and link: the M2RTS definition and implementation establish the expected runtime ABI for module initialization, registration, termination, HALT, and exception-reporting hooks, but implement them as stubs; the SYSTEM pair provides the compiler-recognized low-level machine model interface, builtin types, addresses, and size/word operations with essentially no executable runtime; and the libc definition plus C file form the tiny foreign interface and backing symbols for basic libc-style entry points such as abort and exit. Together, this module is the skeletal runtime substrate that satisfies gm2 front-end and linker expectations without full startup, exception, or host library machinery.
